items.name: Sylvia
items.text: Very efficient, friendly and professional service. Great communication since the initial contact. They arrived at the agreed time and completed the work on time. … The site of the work was left in perfect condition.

items.name: Ali-Efkan Kaya
items.text: I hired GMA Airconditioning to install an air conditioning system in my establishment and could not be more satisfied with the service. From start to finish, they were professional, efficient and delivered high quality work. … I strongly recommend the company.

items.name: Graham Bremner
items.text: … He visited the house, provided a quote, we accepted it and the installation was done in a day and it worked very well. I highly recommend it.

items.name: Bryan Kirkwood
items.text: Excellent service, very experienced professionals and great cost-effectiveness. I would not look for another place for maintenance and air-conditioning repairs.
